en: First, we need to charge the Electrohammer...
<CLT=cltMIND>But I shouldn't just stand around, waiting.
<CLT=cltMIND>I need to make up for lost time...
<CLT=cltMIND>There has to be something I can do.

Nice job, Mister <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=typeNORMAL>.
That was a wise call, Shuichi.
But your talent is useless now.

The mystery of the killing game, the secret of
the outside world, the mastermind's identity...

They're all solved! We don't need a detective
anymore! This is the true <CLT=cltSTRONG>ending<CLT=typeNORMAL>!

<CLT=cltMIND>No, that's not true...
There has to be something I can do.
...Right, I should scout the area.

<CLT=cltMIND>It would be a good idea to check out
the scene before we execute the plan.
<CLT=cltMIND>And...I'm worried about Kaito.
<CLT=cltMIND>He's hurt, and...he's sick...

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sure he doesn't want me to worry
about him, but...I have to.
Alright, I'll go.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>How many more nights do I have to
sleep in this bed? I'm so...sick of it!

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>My closet is filled with
uniforms exactly like mine...

<CLT=cltMIND>They went through all this just for a
killing game? What is their objective...?

<CLT=cltMIND>We're going to use this tomorrow.
I have to make sure mine charges.
